701:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you think you were wrong, just apologize! Even elementary school teaches you that!」

701:t_102:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$トライダー$$ and I will punch some sense into a stubborn egghead who can't even do that!」

701:t_102:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That courage and fighting spirit that fear no one! I... Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$, will crush them!」

701:t_103:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, bearer of the sun. Offer your existence to me.」

701:t_103:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We fight for people who want peace! We're different from someone like you, who fights with nothing to protect!」

701:t_103:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I have a mission as a Dimension General!」

701:t_103:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Being bound by that is no different from a machine that only follows orders! Remember what truly matters!!」

701:t_103:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even if I lose that, I still have what I've built up through battle! As long as that remains, I will keep fighting!!」

701:t_104:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Demon God of Light. Offer your battle to me.」

701:t_104:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「You plan to beat me and $$マジンガー$$, then go straight on to fight the $$御使い$$s?! I won't let you!」

701:t_104:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「If you deny coexistence with us, I won't hesitate to fight! That's my battle as the one entrusted with $$マジンガー$$!」

701:t_104:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even god-killing power cannot break that will...」

701:t_104:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will shatter that light! And I will surpass even the Demon God!」

701:t_105:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Spare me the bullshit, $$ヴィルダーク$$. In the end, you just got swallowed up by battle, like $$ガイオウ$$.」

701:t_105:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will not deny it. But the same is true of you, warrior of $$ゲッター線$$.」

701:t_105:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't lump me in with you. I don't have time for meaningless battles.」

701:t_105:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The $$御使い$$s are my targets! If anyone gets in my way, I'll just beat them and move on!」

701:t_105:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That will to evolve infinitely is the mark of a warrior of $$ゲッター線$$! You are truly a worthy opponent for me!!」

701:t_106:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you mourn the people you've sacrificed at all, you should be able to stop fighting!」

701:t_106:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It is the opposite. That is precisely why I keep fighting.」

701:t_106:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「Stop! Your mission isn't to fight! It should be to end the fighting!」

701:t_106:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you've mistaken the means for the end, I'll stop you by any means necessary!!」

701:t_106:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That strong will... So you've completely united light and darkness within yourself...!」

701:t_106:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That will become the power to defeat them...! But I will surpass even that!!」

701:t_107:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「My drill will crush your fighting spirit!」

701:t_107:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then my fighting aura will crush that drill!」

701:t_107:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Even if you break my drill, my soul will crush you!」

701:t_107:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「No one can crush me! For I have gained the power to kill even gods!」

701:t_107:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's settle this, $$ヴィルダーク$$! We'll go all the way, and the winner will defeat the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_107:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Just as I desire, Spiral Man! I will surpass you, who pierced the heavens!!」

701:t_108:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$...! You have a flame burning in your heart, too!」

701:t_108:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「It's a pale blue flame...! It's cold and sad... but strong!」

701:t_108:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You can feel my fighting aura. What a waste that you're women.」

701:t_108:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Being male or female doesn't matter when you fight to protect peace! And our flames will never lose to you, bound by battle!」

701:t_108:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Prove those words by fighting me!」

701:t_108:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Here we come, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

701:t_108:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「With $$ガンバスター$$, we'll overcome everyone who stands in our way!!」

701:t_109:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Now I can tell...! You also hide hard work and guts in your heart!」

701:t_109:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Of course. That is the source of all fighting spirit.」

701:t_109:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then I won't lose! I'll fight you with my hard work and guts at full power!」

701:t_109:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you've laid bare your fighting spirit! Now you are a worthy opponent for me!」

701:t_109:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Don't think you can keep playing emperor or general forever! I'll end your fighting right here!!」

701:t_110:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You've lived to fight. Perhaps you're the same as $$ノノ$$.」

701:t_110:1.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「You've lived to fight. Perhaps you're the same as $$ノノ$$.」

701:t_110:2.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「You've lived to fight. Perhaps you're the same as $$ノノ$$.」

701:t_110:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Exactly. We are the same kind of beings.」

701:t_110:4.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No! $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis and irreplaceable friends!」

701:t_110:5.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「No! $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis and irreplaceable friends!」

701:t_110:6.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「No! $$ノノ$$ has Big Sis and irreplaceable friends!」

701:t_110:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ has no intention of becoming like you, driving yourself into solitude through battle!」

701:t_110:8.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「$$ノノ$$ has no intention of becoming like you, driving yourself into solitude through battle!」

701:t_110:9.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「$$ノノ$$ has no intention of becoming like you, driving yourself into solitude through battle!」

701:t_110:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is the destiny of the strong! If you claim to have surpassed it, offer that power to me!!」

701:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「My blood is heating up... It seems I don't have any right to judge you.」

701:t_111:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is good, heir to the blood of the beast. That heat is proof you are alive, and the primal strength of living things... life itself.」

701:t_111:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come at me with every instinct you have! I will surpass even that!」

701:t_111:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is god-killing power...! It is the ultimate strength of living things!!」

701:t_111:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Don't just declare your own strength the finished product!」

701:t_111:5.en:
$$葵$$
「I won't stop here! I'll surpass even you and go further!!」

701:t_112:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Even office workers can protect peace! What the hell are you doing?!」

701:t_112:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「You were a general and an emperor! If you hadn't used the wrong methods, you could have gathered the strength to protect peace, but...!」

701:t_112:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That would not defeat them.」

701:t_112:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「You can't know the outcome until you try! In the end, everything you did was selfish!」

701:t_112:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will accept those words, too...」

701:t_112:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I will move forward! I'll surpass you with this god-killing power!!」

701:t_112:7.en:
$$赤木$$
「You stubborn bastard! Then an office worker from Earth and $$ダイ・ガード$$ will break that god-killing power you're so proud of!」

701:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「We are already past the point of exchanging words.」

701:t_113:1.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Exactly. What this universe demands is power.」

701:t_113:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You've disappointed me, $$ヴィルダーク$$. You should have changed that, yet in the end you rely on power, too.」

701:t_113:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then what do you intend to use to stop me and the $$御使い$$s?」

701:t_113:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then you're the same as me...」

701:t_113:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's not it, $$ヴィルダーク$$! I will defeat you with power, and then reject power itself!」

701:t_113:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And I'll tell you that the power you believed in means nothing!」

701:t_113:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, negotiator! I understand your reasoning!」

701:t_113:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then prove it! I will refute your reasoning with power!!」

701:t_114:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Come, Mechanical Angel! Offer me the memories of anger and hatred toward the $$御使い$$s sleeping within you!」

701:t_114:1.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Sure, $$アクエリオン$$ may be full of the $$天翅$$s' grudges, too...!」
